evidence_level: revealed development cross-validation conditional on an oracle ROI
objective: Predict ROI-384 versus ROI-512 using reusable ROI-384 patch embedding plus one vision block.

policy.type: ridge regression on continuous utility gain

cost_proxy: vision-block-token work: low choice=24*ROI384 tokens; high choice=1*ROI384 tokens+24*ROI512 tokens; patch embedding, merger and fixed costs reported separately

gate.noninferiority_rule: paired 95% bootstrap lower bound must be at or above the margin

mandatory_boundary: ROI is generated from ground truth in this conditional experiment. No region-localization claim is allowed.
